caption: The drawing depicts a single piece of furniture, specifically a sofa with an antique or classical design. The sofa has a wooden frame with a brown tone and features scrolled armrests that curve outward on both sides. The seat and backrest areas are cushioned and share the same brown coloring, which appears to be rendered with shading to suggest texture and depth. The lower front edge of the sofa is adorned with gold-colored decorative elements, and the two front legs are elaborately carved, each ending in a gold caster. The overall composition centers the sofa against a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or scenery. There is a small, handwritten inscription in the lower right corner.
title: Sofa
